text: 10 OVERDOSAGE In the event of an overdose of bexagliflozin tablets, consider contacting the Poison Help line (1-800-222-1222) or a medical toxicologist for additional overdosage management recommendations. Employ the usual supportive measures as dictated by the patient’s clinical status. Removal of bexagliflozin by hemodialysis has not been studied.
